name: Carrot Time
source:
This is a story of two lovers - bunny girl Carrot and fox boy Tail -  who live in a small village at the corner of a fantasy world. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是关于两个恋人——兔女郎胡萝卜和狐狸男孩泰尔——住在奇幻世界角落的一个小村庄里的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
